description: Prefer this to deleting a relation and creating another: change the type of existing relations and/or repoint their endpoints. Each entry is matched by its current from, to and relationType; a missing match is reported, not thrown, so the batch keeps its other entries.

relations.description: One entry per relation: its current from/to/relationType and the new values

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

newFrom.description: The new start entity; omit to keep the current one

newRelationType.description: The new relation type; omit to keep the current one

newTo.description: The new end entity; omit to keep the current one

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

name: update_relations
title: Update Relations
